resolutions.rationale: The fixed U-002 union includes both the broader authority or leading-position person use and the education-head specialization, so an education-only sense omitted supported coverage.
required_changes: Restore the supported broader person-in-authority use without weakening the distinct education-head realization.
implemented_changes: Broadened sense 2 and its core-image branch to authority or leading-position persons, retained the education-head specialization, and supplied separate complete organization and education frames with examples.

resolutions.rationale: The fixed U-003 union includes a leading performing-arts performer as well as an orchestral section leader, so an orchestra-only sense omitted supported coverage.
required_changes: Restore the supported performing-arts principal use while preserving the distinct orchestral realization.
implemented_changes: Broadened sense 3 and its core-image branch to performing-arts principal performers, retained the orchestra specialization, and supplied separate complete performing-arts and orchestra frames with examples.
